title: Shopify theme presets — 5 ready store styles | UTD Shopify Themes
description:
One theme, five finished stores. Boutique ships with five presets — Aurum, Boutique, Jade, Noom and Reflections — and every option is in all five: sections and layouts, galleries and lookbooks, colour swatches, filters and quick view, product options, sizes and stock, trust and support. No apps to add. Try it free and pay only when you publish.
👉 https://themes.shopify.com/themes/boutique
